newsitem.title: GERMANY: German chemical industry nine-month sales down.
newsitem.headline: German chemical industry nine-month sales down.

text.p: The German chemical industry saw improved sales in the third quarter but still experienced an overall drop of 2.5 percent for the first nine months of 1996, the German chemical association VCI said on Thursday.
The VCI said sales during the first half of the year fell 5.5 percent but production rose in the third quarter to cut the drop to 2.5 percent.
Production also recovered in the third quarter after falling 3.5 percent in the first half of 1996, the VCI said.
For all of 1996, the VCI said it expected a drop of one percent in sales and a rise of one percent in production.
The VCI is scheduled to hold a news conference later on Thursday to discuss the state of industry conditions.
